name: Store Check
description: What Google Play and the App Store show about your apps: icons, screenshots, versions, privacy forms, and what changed since last week.
reads: The public Google Play and App Store pages of the apps you list, and the version in your project folder

settings.label: Apps
settings.hint: android is the Google Play package name; ios is the bundle id or the number in the App Store link; project is optional, the folder whose version is compared with the stores; playForm is optional, your answers to Google Play's Data safety form, in the project or anywhere

settings.label: Store country
settings.hint: Two-letter country of the storefront to read, e.g. us or tr; if empty: us
